description:
Get petroleum/oil prices — crude oil spot prices (WTI, Brent), retail gasoline prices, diesel, heating oil.

Product codes:
- EPCBRENT: Brent crude oil spot price
- EPCWTI: WTI crude oil spot price
- EMM_EPMRU_PTE_NUS_DPG: US regular gasoline retail
- EMM_EPMPU_PTE_NUS_DPG: US premium gasoline retail
- EMD_EPD2D_PTE_NUS_DPG: US diesel retail
- EER_EPJK_PF4_RGC_DPG: US jet fuel spot price

end.description: End date (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Default: latest available

length.description: Max rows to return (API max: 5000). Omit to let date range control volume.

offset.description: Row offset for pagination (use with length)

product.description: Product type: 'crude' (default — WTI), 'gasoline', 'diesel', 'all'. Or a specific series ID like 'EPCWTI'

start.description: Start date (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 2 years ago

name: eia_petroleum
